t: The Lutec Try Outdoor LED solar wall light provides a completely wire-free lighting solution, ideal for enhancing security and visibility around properties. This solar-powered unit, finished in matt black, delivers 500 lumens of cool white light, making it suitable for electricians installing outdoor lighting and homeowners seeking reliable illumination. It features an integrated PIR sensor with a 10-metre range, offering three lighting modes: 'On' for constant dusk-to-dawn brightness, 'Auto' for motion-activated light, and 'Dim' for a low glow that brightens upon movement. Its IP54-rated polycarbonate construction ensures durability and resistance for various outdoor applications.
